caveats: the drift is a PRICE drift: it contains the two funds' premium changes as well as their fees and tracking, and this book has no NAV panel to split the two -- it is what a holder of the sibling actually experiences, not a fee estimate
the reconstruction inherits the sibling-gap face's single IOPV anchor; changes cancel that offset, so the drift and the noise are identified even though the level is not

the noise is scaled on the 120-session variance ratio because the relative price mean reverts; the iid figure beside it is an upper bound, and neither is a forecast -- beyond 120 sessions this sample cannot estimate the ratio at all
an unmeasurable leg is refused with a reason, never scored as zero drift and never scored as zero noise (r1230 family)
the concentration block prices the DIFFERENCE between one fund and two; it says nothing about either fund's tracking against its index, which needs NAV
sentence: 这一单没有换出任何票：价差面在这根 bar 上没有可配对的腿，所以没有成本可量——这不是「跟踪差为零」的结论。
